summary: Phase 3 Dealer Warranty Parts (usage, stores dept dashboard, RMA) fully tested backend + frontend. All 9 pytest cases pass; all UI flows work (log usage decrements stock and creates ledger movement + case timeline event best-effort, Stores Dept dashboard renders 4 cards + queues, RMA create/inline status change works).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/dealer_parts_ops.py imports safe_regex but never uses it — dead import (minor lint).

log_usage: if part_sku has no matching STORE_STOCK row, stock is not decremented BUT a 'part_used' movement is still recorded — invariant that 'no stock changes without a ledger row' holds, but a phantom movement is created for parts never held (arguably fine for Phase 4 failure monitoring, but worth noting).

_ensure_usage_store may auto-create a 'Main Dealer Store' as a side-effect of a validation-failing request path if the dealer has no stores; consider deferring creation until after quantity/sku validation passes (currently validated first, so OK).
